Usage: gotools purge [options]

  Remove all tools and the .gotools.json manifest. With --restore, the managed
  tools are added back to the root go.mod at their pinned versions (go get
  -tool) before the wipe, and the init command that recreates this project is
  printed.

  Interactive: requires typing YES to confirm.

  Examples:
    gotools purge
    gotools purge --restore
    gotools purge --restore --dry-run

  Options:
    --restore  Put the managed tools back into the root go.mod
    --dry-run  Show what would be removed without deleting
